description: Seed-independent relevance fixture for @cnote/search (ADR-009). The corpus below is built INSIDE the test/eval run (never read from the seed database), so it keeps working when real catalogue data replaces the dummy seed. Items are keyed by the slug of their title. Grades: 3 ideal, 2 relevant, 1 related, absent = not relevant. Judged by hand from the product's sense, NOT tuned to the ranker; add real queries from the admin judgement export (docs/design/search-vernacular-image-voice.md).
